title: Azure Key Vault Encryption Wrapper
domain: CLOUD SECURITY / ENVELOPE ENCRYPTION / KEY MANAGEMENT
subtitle: Encrypt sensitive fields, wrap the data key and retain the exact key version.
scenario: A workforce platform handles sensitive onboarding and payroll fields. Database/storage encryption alone does not enforce application-level field access. Records also need protection against tampering, wrong-record reuse and losing decryption after key rotation.
outcome: Add an application-level protection layer around sensitive records while keeping key custody, historical reads and recovery explicit.
flow: Authorize the request and resolve the record context
Generate a fresh AES key and encrypt the value
Wrap that data key with the Key Vault RSA key
Store ciphertext, nonce, tag and exact key version
Unwrap the recorded version and authenticate the same context
notes: This run uses real AES-GCM/RSA cryptography with ephemeral in-memory keys, not an Azure Key Vault emulator or live service.
The actual Node source tests isolate field encryption with injected wrapper fixtures. The Python example additionally uses real local RSA wrapping.
Public AAD labels and formats are reference namespaces, not a migration or a drop-in decoder for actual stored records.
No private key, real sensitive value or cloud credential is written to disk or returned by the dashboard.
boundary: Actual implementation excerpts plus a real local crypto exercise using fictional values; no cloud request.
